senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (शटति)
1 To be diseased or sick.
2 To divide, to pierce or separate.
3 To go.
4 To be low spirited, to be weary or dejected.
r. 10th cl. (शाटयति)
To flatter, to praise.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Sour, astringent, acid.
E.
शट to pain, aff. अच्.

f. (-टा)
An ascetic's clotted hair: see सटा.

r. 1st cl. (सटति)
To be a part or portion.

r. 10th cl. (षट्टयति)
1 To injure, to hurt or kill.
2 To give.
3 To be strong.
4 To dwell.

r. 1st (सटयति)
To manifest.

mfn. subst. (-टः-टा-टं)
An ascetic's clotted hair, or the hair collected into a loose braid and twisted forwards upon the forehead.
2 A mane.
3 A crest.
E.
षट to be a part of, and अच् aff.

r. 10th cl. (सट्टयति)
To hurt or kill.

f. (-टिः or -टी)
Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet,) otherwise considered as a synonym of the Ambahaldi, or Curcuma Amhaldi, the mango-smelling ginger, so termed because the fresh root possesses the smell of a green mango.
E.
शट to divide (remove disease), aff. इन, and ङीष optionally added.

mf. (-टः-टी)
A petticoat.
E.
शट to praise or flatter, to go, &c. aff. ण, fem. aff. ङीष्.

f. (-टिः-टी)
Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet,) but applied also to the Curcuma amada: see सटि.
E.
षट to be a part of, इन् aff. and ङीष् optionally added.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A petticoat.
E.
शट to go, (round the limbs,) ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-कं)
A sort of minor drama in Prākṛta only.

n. (-ट्यं)
Wickedness, villainy.
E.
शठ wicked, ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-ट्कः-ट्का-ट्कं)
1 Six.
2 Having six, six-fold, &c.
E.
षष् six, and कन् poss. aff.

m. (-र्णः)
A sort of lute.
E.
षष् six, and कर्ण an ear.

m. (-र्म्मा)
1 A Brahman.
2 An adept, (in the Tantras, &c.)
n. (-र्म्म or pl. र्म्माणि)
1 The six acts proper for a Brahman, (collectively,) or teaching the Vedas, holy study, offering sacrifices, conducting them for others, giving, accepting gifts.
2 Six acts allowable to a Brahman for subsistence, or gleaning, accepting gifts, asking alms, agriculture, trade, and tending cattle, or according to some lending money at interest.
3 The six acts taught in the Tantras, or killing, infatuating, enthralling, expelling, exciting animosity, and the stopping or privation of any faculty.
E.
षष् six, कर्म्मन् act or duty.

n. (-णं)
1 A hexagon, a six-angled figure.
2 The thunderbolt of INDRA.
E.
षष् six, कोण a corner.

m. (-णः)
A bee.
E.
षष् six, and चरण a foot.

f. (-शत्)
1 Thirty-six.
2 A work on law.
E.
षष् six, and त्रिंशत् thirty.

m. (-दः)
A bee.
mf. (-दः-दी)
A louse.
E.
षष् six, and पद a foot.

m. (-यः)
The Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea.)
E.
षट्पद a bee, and प्रिय beloved by; equally applicable therefore to the lotus, jasmine, &c.

m. (-थिः)
1 The mango tree.
2 The Champaka.
E.
षट्पद a bee, अतिथि a guest.

m. (-ज्ञः)
1 A sage, one acquainted with the four objects of human existence, or virtue, wealth, desire, and final happiness, and with the nature of the world, and of divine truth.
2 A catamite.
E.
षष् six, and प्रज्ञ who knows.

ind.
An interjection of calling.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Enveloped in six sheathes.
E.
षट्, and कोश a sheath, ठक् aff.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A lion.
E.
सटा mane, and अङ्क mark.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Accompanied or explained by a commentary.
E.
स with, टीका a comment.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Proud, haughty, consequential.
n. adv. (-पं)
Arrogantly, consequentially.
E.
स with, आटोप pride.
